components.purpose: External Sony PlayStation runtime for private stock Play and isolated Lab
components.licence: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0; upstream treats preconfigured packages/settings as modifications. Build files have additional packaging restrictions.
components.delivery: Owner-authorised private stock installation from unchanged official ZIP. Public preconfigured packaging and automated configuration need a separate rights decision.
components.verification: Match official release 423115112, asset 673934896, length and GitHub asset SHA-256. Check contents and executable identity. Record platform signature result separately.
components.maintenance: Use separate portable directories. Reverify immutable files. Qualify new releases beside the stable release; preserve cards, configuration and states.

components.purpose: Reference emulator for replacement firmware, disc layout and isolated compatibility testing
components.licence: GPL-2.0, individual core files permit version 2 or later. Retain dependency notices and supply corresponding source for redistribution.
components.delivery: Unchanged development-channel build, private Lab only; use its own OpenBIOS as provenance reference.
components.verification: Match build 879 size, SHA3-256 and SHA-1 from the official manifest, then cross-check the embedded version.json and source changeset. SHA-256 below was computed from those verified bytes.
components.maintenance: Pin the dev build, disable automatic updates in Lab sessions and isolate all writable directories. Reacquire the same digest for repair.

components.purpose: Local-only scripted compatibility and save regression runs with the standalone console entry point
components.licence: GPL-2.0 and component notices. The CLI skips the ordinary Windows GUI entry point's crash collector.
components.delivery: Private Lab development channel. Run the verified console binary with the network debugger, web server and updater disabled.
components.verification: The official manifest supplies size, SHA-1 and SHA3-256. Its embedded version and the firmware member are verified separately.
components.maintenance: Keep a fixed build for frame-based testing. Requalify the fixture and game sequence on a new version.

components.purpose: Private interactive reference Lab on Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64 with isolated per-session cards
components.licence: GPL-2.0 and per-component notices. Public redistribution must cover the exact corresponding source, dependencies and firmware notices.
components.delivery: Owner-authorised private Lab acquisition of the unchanged official ZIP. The embedded AppImage runs as an ordinary user using extraction without FUSE.
components.verification: Match official build 570 size, SHA3-256 and SHA-1. Validate the sole AppImage, its embedded version.json and its standard OpenBIOS member against recorded fingerprints.
components.maintenance: Keep the installed AppImage and firmware separate from game sessions. Qualify later builds before adopting them. Preserve old versions, cards and settings.

components.purpose: Candidate replacement firmware for private Lab gameplay
components.licence: Nugget MIT; preserve font credits and review embedded shell jingle and linked components before public distribution.
components.delivery: Extract only the standard openbios.bin from the pinned, verified official PCSX-Redux package. Do not select cart, fastboot, UniROM or ELF builds.
components.verification: 512 KiB. OpenBIOS marker and SHA-256 of the exact member of the vetted package. Test separate Cold Boot, gameplay, transitions, ordinary card save/load and later routes for both games.
components.maintenance: Keep exact firmware digest in session and state locks. Retail NTSC-U user-file import remains independent. Promotion requires named real-game results on the requested backend.

components.version: compatible supported Visual C++ redistributable checked on target
components.licence: Microsoft terms restrict redistribution to eligible licensed Visual Studio users.
components.delivery: Reuse an installed supported runtime; otherwise open Microsoft's architecture-matched installer through the OS.
components.verification: Verify Microsoft signature, installed architecture and application startup on each target.
components.maintenance: Repair via the official Windows installer. Leave shared prerequisites in place when removing Atelier.

components.purpose: Stream safe extraction of user archives without player-installed tools
components.licence: New BSD and per-file or enabled codec notices.
components.delivery: Use a vetted compatible OS library or package an audited build and codecs required for ZIP and 7z.
components.verification: Validate supported compression methods against both owner archives and bounded synthetic error cases.
components.maintenance: Replace only through tested application upgrades; preserve imported content and receipts.

components.purpose: Physical gamepad input and controller mapping
components.version: pin SDL and device mappings per packaged shell
components.licence: SDL uses zlib; review separate mappings and attribution before packaging.
components.delivery: Prefer application-managed native input; use runtime-provided SDL in the external runtime.
components.verification: Record library fingerprint and physical controller model, connection, disconnect/reconnect, and process focus on each OS.
components.maintenance: Keep mappings versioned with reset and keyboard recovery. Preserve saved player remaps.
